Dental cement secures crowns, and temporary fillings seal access cavities. The hygienist applies desensitizing paste around exposed roots. A custom acrylic night guard fits over the upper teeth to cushion against heavy jaw clenching and nocturnal grinding. A dentist examines teeth, and a hygienist scales calculus. The patient wears the protective night guard during sleep. A dental assistant prepares the treatment operatory, aspirates fluids with high-volume suction, and passes sterile instruments. A receptionist schedules visits, and an oral surgeon performs extractions. The dental assistant hands the composite syringe to the doctor. An orthodontist is a dental specialist who diagnoses malocclusion and installs braces or clear aligners to straighten teeth. A pediatric dentist treats young children, and a periodontist treats gum disease. The patient consults an orthodontist about crowded incisors. A child patient visits the pediatric operatory for preventive fluoride varnishes and gentle cavity screenings. A parent observes from the corner chair, and a technician makes models. The hygienist demonstrates brushing technique to the young child patient.
